author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
In this video, I show you how I build out the tread and riser, apply the adhesive, mix the thinset, back butter the tile, and install everything with the proper stair nosing.
At around $50 per step, tile can be a durable and affordable option with excellent traction, but it takes more preparation and specialty tools than some other stair finishes.
Watch the full comparison video to see how tile stacks up against hardwood, vinyl, veneer, and sanding and staining👇🏼
